title: Poster Series – Rooted in Ideas
description: Three posters that translate the brand line and the five-step process into print – alternating dark, light and green.

thumbnail.alt: Dark poster with a river at sunset and the words 'Rooted in ideas.'

body: Each poster carries one part of the brand: the tagline in two halves, and the process from idea to execution.
The layouts follow the website's rhythm – dark, light, green – and use the image language of the CI: warm light, deep shadows, nature.
